Name: Classic Performance CPP-UJ9: Classic Performance Steering U-Joints
Natural: Classic Performance CPP-UJ9: U-Joint, Steering, Standard Style, Steel, Nickel Plated, 13/16 in. 36-spline, 3/4 in. DD, Each - These Classic Performance steering U-joints are as attractive as they are functional. Classic Performance has manufactured these U-joints to be extremely strong--perfect for your classic musclecar or hot rod. Each U-joint is CNC-machined and precision-broached to produce the finest, strongest piece available.
